name: hgi_xp_aq_bypass13_1018-p1-COMMIT
purpose: PRE-QUANTISED bypass beside each x-load quantiser tile (x_fmt 3, QBG)

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_xp_aq_bypass13 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers/ot_hgi_sm_xload_static_cl2p.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hgi_xp_aq_bypass13_1018/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hgi_xp_aq_bypass13_1018/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hgi_xp_aq_bypass13_1018 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hgi_xp_aq_bypass13  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: new PRE bypass tile (13-edge delay line, q = x[255:0], e = x[263:256]-127, range fault): ports and pin faces identical to the CLOSED ot_hbm_xp_aq_tree13 (W clk/rst_n/v/fp4, S x, N q/e/y/vo/fault) so it drops beside each quantiser on the same l_d_o source; 183.6 wide like tree13, height 64.8 (3.4k flops; pin-limited: S 1,024 x pins 5.6/um, N 780 4.2/um)
